_about: Feature 313 (spec FR-011): the access states, in order from the most open, and the states recorded by hand. The tag itself is DERIVED each time by scripts/_access_tags.py from the archive manifest, the registry's READ comments and the GM's recorded marks in research/to-download.md; `recorded` holds only what nothing else records, written by `make access-tags SET=` (a state, the date its evidence was seen, and what it rests on).

states.name: Open
states.description: Read by us: the archive captured it (live or from a Wayback snapshot), or its registry entry records a read.

states.name: The GM's full copy
states.description: The GM downloaded the whole work; the archive holds the copy.

states.name: The GM's partial copy
states.description: The GM could get only part of it: an abstract or an excerpt.

states.name: Paywalled
states.description: It needs a paid or institutional login.

states.name: Refused to us
states.description: Once read, it now refuses our fetch (a bot wall, HTTP 403, 406 or 429, or a page that will not render); it may open in a browser.

states.name: Down
states.description: Once read, it now times out, drops the connection or answers with a server error.

states.name: Gone
states.description: Once read, it now answers 404 or 410, and no copy was found.

states.name: Never read
states.description: Referenced only: no read of it is recorded and no capture of it is open.
